notes: SDSS J160429.12+100002.2 (= J1604+1000) is included as follow_up: T:p2-b1 states that it seemed to be a hypervelocity star, defined there as gravitationally unbound, and the title T:p1-b1 calls it a candidate hypervelocity B-type star. This is not candidates_found because the final analysis finds the system bound: T:p7-b9 reports that v_Grf - v_esc is well below zero and states that the system is gravitationally bound to the Milky Way. The unseen companion is a brown-dwarf candidate, not an independently named Galactic-unbound candidate star, so it is not counted separately.

SDSS J160429.12+100002.2: RA/Dec are not explicitly tabulated; they are parsed from the SDSS coordinate designation and left in sexagesimal notation. No numeric proper motions, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probabilities are reported, so those quantities are omitted. Table 5 distances depend on the assumed Roche-lobe filling factor x. The parallax is retained as reported, 0.117 - Z mas, with adopted Z = -0.017 mas; no conversion was applied. The 740 ± 140 km/s rest-frame velocity is for the preliminary BHB interpretation; the revised bound-orbit discussion reports only v_Grf - v_esc = -150^{+120} km/s (lower uncertainty absent in the supplied transcription), not a revised total v_Grf. Table 1 values are heliocentric radial velocities of the visible component; the systemic velocity is not corrected for gravitational redshift.
